correction_from_v1: Before implementation or model access, add explicit price gates and replace the structurally weak rank-seven projector-overlap restart test with absolute cosine of the uniquely discarded normal inside the fixed rank-eight teacher. Scientific target and all loss weights are unchanged.
question: Can strongly constrained, regularized DAS compress the transferable checkpoint-derived rank-eight teacher to a stable rank-seven causal variable without task memorization?

authority.diagnosis: Rank seven transfers tensor geometry, complement selectivity, and downstream transport but misses v9 A2 behavior by 0.67 points; unconstrained scalar cDAS and raw response-SVD selected the wrong objects.

frozen_hypothesis_class.teacher: The exact checkpoint-only rank-eight member of the v8 nested reader family.
frozen_hypothesis_class.student: A rank-seven hyperplane inside that fixed rank-eight teacher. Parameterize only its unit discarded normal in teacher coordinates (eight raw parameters); the remaining 120 H3 dimensions are inaccessible to the optimizer.
frozen_hypothesis_class.initialization: The exact checkpoint-only rank-seven normal plus two fixed random restarts.

frozen_objective.environments: v1 and v2, A1 and A2 separately; even rows train and odd rows select. No v8/v9 gradients or selection.
frozen_objective.sufficiency: Full-vocabulary KL from full-H3 intervention to rank-seven student intervention, normalized by each environment's full-H3-versus-base KL.
frozen_objective.complement: Full-vocabulary KL from base to the student's exact orthogonal-complement intervention, with the same normalization.
frozen_objective.environment_balance: Mean of the four environment losses plus 0.5 times their population variance; checkpoint selection minimizes the worst odd-row environment loss.
frozen_objective.noise: Antithetic tangent noise on the eight-dimensional unit normal, sigma 0.03, averaged during every update.
frozen_objective.anchor: 0.1 times squared Frobenius distance from the initial checkpoint-derived rank-seven projector.
frozen_objective.optimization: Adam, learning rate 0.02, 150 updates per restart, three restarts; checkpoint every 10 updates; model weights frozen.

frozen_evaluation.populations: All previously capability-qualified v8 and v9 rows, evaluated only after the student is selected.
frozen_evaluation.metrics: Behavioral fraction of full H3, exact complement fraction, L15H5/H1 transport, full-vocabulary KL, discarded-normal restart agreement, and projector distance from the tensor initialization.
frozen_evaluation.success: At least 90% behavior and transport and at most 12% absolute complement in both panels of both banks; strictly improve v9 A2 behavior over fixed weight rank seven; minimum pairwise absolute cosine among the three selected discarded normals at least 0.80.
frozen_evaluation.status: Discovery/validation screen only; any successful student requires a new v10 capability bank for confirmation.

decision: If the regularized student passes, freeze it for v10. If it fails but rank eight remains sufficient, prefer the transparent rank-eight tensor variable. If discarded-normal restarts disagree, the constrained objective remains underidentified despite regularization.
